P01_PANTHEON_PLUS.release: Pantheon+ SH0ES (Scolnic et al. 2022; Brout et al. 2022)
P01_PANTHEON_PLUS.retrieval_recipe: Retrieved from official GitHub repository github.com/PantheonPlusSH0ES/DataRelease

data_table.selection_criteria: Cosmological sample: z_HD in [0.01, 2.26], valid covariance mapping
data_table.units: z: heliocentric/CMB redshift; m_b_corr: apparent B-band mag (Vega); ra/dec: degrees (ICRF)

covariance_matrix.description: Full statistical + systematic error covariance matrix

catalogue.selection_criteria: G < 20.0 mag sample, spectroscopic+photometric redshift z in [0.5, 3.5]
catalogue.units: ra, dec: degrees (ICRF); z: redshift; phot_g_mean_mag: Gaia G magnitude

randoms.description: 10x unclustered random catalog modulated by Quaia selection mask

selection_function.description: HEALPix selection map accounting for dust extinction, stellar density, and scan patterns

kinematic_coupling.derivation: Ellis & Baldwin (1984) relation: C_EB = 2 + x_s*(1 + alpha), with x_s = 0.88, alpha = 0.50

P03_NVSS_RADIO_DIPOLE.probe_name: NRAO VLA Sky Survey (NVSS) 1.4 GHz Radio Catalogue

catalogue.selection_criteria: Flux density S_1.4GHz >= 20 mJy, declination Dec >= -40 deg, galactic plane cut |b| > 10 deg

kinematic_coupling.derivation: Ellis & Baldwin (1984) relation: C_EB = 2 + x_s*(1 + alpha), with x_s = 1.05, alpha = 0.75

P04_GAIA_CRF3_ASTROMETRIC_VSH.probe_name: Gaia DR3 Celestial Reference Frame 3 (CRF3) Quasars
P04_GAIA_CRF3_ASTROMETRIC_VSH.release: Gaia DR3 (Gaia Collaboration et al. 2022; Klioner et al. 2022)
P04_GAIA_CRF3_ASTROMETRIC_VSH.license: ESA / Gaia Open Data (ODbL / CC-BY-SA 3.0 IGO)
P04_GAIA_CRF3_ASTROMETRIC_VSH.retrieval_recipe: Retrieved from ESA Gaia Archive and cross-matched with Quaia CRF3 quasars

joined_catalogue.units: pmra, pmdec: mas/yr; pmra_uasyr, pmdec_uasyr: microarcsec/yr; ICRF3 frame

kinematic_coupling.decomposition: Vector Spherical Harmonics (E1 dipolar glide, B1 frame spin / cosmic vorticity, E2 quadrupolar shear)
kinematic_coupling.gauge_note: B1 magnetic dipole is strictly degenerate with ICRF spin and is unanchored without independent VLBI tie.

P05_PLANCK_PR4_LOWELL_CMB.probe_name: Planck PR4 (NPIPE) Low-Ell CMB Polarization and Temperature
P05_PLANCK_PR4_LOWELL_CMB.release: Planck PR4 (Planck Collaboration 2020; Tristram et al. 2021)
P05_PLANCK_PR4_LOWELL_CMB.retrieval_recipe: Retrieved from Planck Legacy Archive (PLA) and NPIPE processed maps

observed_modes.multipoles: ell in [2, 3, 4] for E and B modes
observed_modes.covariance_source: 100 end-to-end NPIPE Monte Carlo realistic simulations
